why: A two-player game where the state is a suffix (you take 1-3 stones from the front), solved with the same score-difference idea: diff[i] = max over k of (stones taken) - diff[i+k].
hints: After any moves the remaining stones are a suffix. What one number per suffix would decide the winner?
diff[i] = best (mover - opponent) from stone i on = max over k in 1..3 of sum(stoneValue[i..i+k-1]) - diff[i+k], with diff[n] = 0.
Fill i from n-1 down to 0 and compare diff[0] with 0. O(n).
pitfalls: Values can be negative, so taking more is not always better, and the mover must take at least one stone.
Near the end only fewer than 3 stones may remain.
